entities.name: Brnjača
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Brnjača was a Serbian princess, the daughter of King Stefan Uroš I and Queen Helen of Anjou. Her brothers were Stefan Dragutin and Stefan Milutin. By birth, she was member of the Nemanjić dynasty, ruling family of the Kingdom of Serbia.
